label: Salt-bridge dissociation, origin-frame 6-statistic recovery difference uncertainty across horizons (G158)

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (30 test proteins, sampled with replacement; unlike the 2-protein bases, the bootstrap distribution takes many distinct values)
bootstrap.note: AUPRC inside the bootstrap uses a numpy reimplementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (same threshold-grouping treatment of ties); it was verified to agree with sklearn to 1e-12 on all fitted conditions before use. Models were retrained per condition and horizon; pooled AUPRCs were verified against G158 records to 4 decimal places. The 11-frame 6-statistic condition is the full-history condition itself, so its recovery is 1.0 by definition, in every bootstrap replicate as well; the recovery difference is 1.0 minus the 10-frame recovery.
